confirmation_benchmark.human_knowledge_disclosure: Public metadata/source code revealed WT fitness and global-max identity TEMH before this preregistration. Those facts are forbidden from scoring, generation, ranking, thresholds, or gates. The test is algorithmically blind, not human-knowledge-blind.
confirmation_benchmark.name: PhoQ four-site combinatorial landscape
confirmation_benchmark.visible: WT + measured singles + measured doubles only

development_history.GB1_and_TrpB: Used only as revealed development datasets to diagnose V3.
development_history.diagnosis: Raw pairwise memory over-counts many pair memories; V3 relative-only resonance is precise but can suppress too much of the measured pair signal.

frozen_formula.degree_normalization: 2 / k, where k is the candidate's mutation count
frozen_formula.dormant: retain candidates with no supported pair evidence
frozen_formula.dream: enumerate all 3/4-mutation candidates independently of hidden IDs

required: V4 top-100 top-1%-tail precision > ADDITIVE and > PAIRWISE_RAW
visible-label shuffle materially collapses top-tail performance
advantage is not only one selected sequence

why_parameter_free: No coefficient was fitted on PhoQ.
2/k is the mean pair-evidence contribution per mutated endpoint, preventing score inflation solely from having C(k,2) pair memories.
(1+r)/2 is an equal cooperative blend of direct measured pair memory and its row-relative mutual-resonance confidence; no scientific threshold is introduced.
